results.corrected_title: Volkswagen Group has given Microsoft Copilot to more than 330,000 employees
results.corrected_summary: On 21 October 2026 Microsoft announced that Volkswagen Group has equipped more than 330,000 employees with Microsoft Copilot. The rollout began with Copilot Chat, which reached upwards of 300,000 monthly active users, and more than 26,000 agents were active across the Group in the past month. Employees now also use Copilot with Work IQ in engineering, production, procurement and sales. The two companies also plan to expand Volkswagen's Intelligent Data Foundation on Microsoft Fabric.
key_facts: More than 330,000 Volkswagen Group employees equipped with Copilot
Copilot Chat reached upwards of 300,000 monthly active users
More than 26,000 agents active across the Group in the past month
Plan to expand the Intelligent Data Foundation on Microsoft Fabric; presented at the Microsoft Frontier Tour in Cologne on 22 October
results.issues: No issues found. All figures match the primary Microsoft source, but the only confirmation is Microsoft's own announcement; no independent coverage was checked.

results.corrected_title: Notion rebuilds its AI agents: 24-hour tasks, own computer and browser, and a new credit system
results.corrected_summary: On 19 October 2026 Notion announced rebuilt agents that can work on a single task for more than 24 hours, up from about five minutes, using their own computer and browser. Notion says its new Auto model router gave results similar to Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90 percent lower average cost across 20+ common use cases, so credits go about 10 times further. A new credit system is live now for new customers, and existing customers move to it on 2 November 2026.
key_facts: Announced 19 October 2026 in a blog post by co-founder Akshay Kothari
Agents can work on a single task for more than 24 hours, up from five minutes
Agents get their own computer and browser and can write scripts
Auto router: results similar to Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower average cost (Notion's own claim, no methodology given)
Business and Enterprise seats get 1,500 Standard and 500 Select credits per month; existing customers move over on 2 November 2026
results.issues: No factual errors. The 90% cost claim is Notion's own and comes without methodology. The release-notes URL was not opened.

results.corrected_title: METR and Redwood red-team review finds gaps in OpenAI's internal monitoring of AI agents
results.corrected_summary: On 22 October 2026 METR published a summary of a pilot high-access red-team exercise by one METR and one Redwood Research employee. Over three weeks (21 July-11 August 2026) they tested OpenAI's internal misalignment monitoring system. They estimate that about 75-94% of agentic internal Responses API traffic from models at least as strong as GPT-5.5 was eligible for monitoring. The issues they found include two client-controllable headers that disabled monitoring for new agents, and unmonitored compaction events that likely left roughly 10% of eligible internal Codex traffic unmonitored from May to July 2026. OpenAI says all identified vulnerabilities affecting its production safeguards have been patched; METR has not evaluated OpenAI's claims about later changes.
key_facts: Published by METR on 22 October 2026; contributors David Rein and Adam Kaufman
Exercise ran 21 July-11 August 2026 with access to internal code, monitor prompts and staff interviews
About 75-94% of agentic internal Responses API traffic from models at least as strong as GPT-5.5 was eligible for monitoring (99.2% for the internal Codex subset)
Roughly 10% of eligible internal Codex traffic likely unmonitored May-July 2026 because compaction events were not monitored; OpenAI found this before the exercise and fixed it during it
Also found: two client-controllable headers that disabled monitoring for new agents, and a possible Codex sandbox bypass
OpenAI says production vulnerabilities are patched
results.issues: Mostly accurate, with two precision fixes. The candidate says 'frontier-model agent traffic', but the source says agentic internal Responses API traffic from models at least as strong as GPT-5.5. The 10% figure is a share of eligible internal Codex traffic, is uncertain, and comes from unmonitored compaction events. The second listed METR URL (2026-10-20) was not opened.
